home.heroTitle: The electric ride a bank can't say no to.
home.heroBody: Adhara means foundation. Pay monthly, with no bank and no credit check — and ride home the moment you're eligible.
home.emiStripBody: Four steps, no lender, nothing hidden.

steps.enrollBody: Pick a model and a tenure. An OTP is all the identity we need.
steps.payBody: A fixed amount every month. No bank, no credit check, no hidden charge.
steps.alertBody: We tell you the moment your vehicle is unlocked for delivery.
steps.rideBody: Home delivery, or collect from your nearest dealer.

home.modelsBody: Every model is built to low-speed specification and carries the same battery-health warranty.
home.calcTeaserTitle: See your monthly number before you decide
home.calcTeaserBody: Pick a model and a tenure. We show the monthly amount, the total, and exactly what the scheme costs against paying in full.

emi.title: The Adhara EMI scheme
emi.subtitle: No bank. No credit check. No surprises.
emi.whyNoBankBody: A bank loan needs a credit history that most first-time riders don't have. Adhara carries that risk instead: you pay us monthly, and your vehicle is released for delivery once you cross the eligibility mark. Nothing is reported to a credit bureau, either way.
emi.termsPending: The versioned scheme terms and conditions publish here once legal sign-off concludes. Until then, ask any dealer for the current terms in writing.

calculator.intro: Pick a model and a tenure. Everything below updates together — including what the scheme costs you over paying in full.
calculator.transparencyNote: This is what the scheme costs compared with paying {amount} today. We show it because you should be able to choose with your eyes open.
